evidence.text:
DU: DAWSON CROSSING - NELSON (WHITE) 115 KV REBUILD
Teams # 18669

Rebuild approximately 15.7 miles of the Dawson Crossing - Etowah - Reavis Mountain - Nelson sections of the Dawson Crossing - Nelson (White) 115kV line with 1351 ACSS conductor. GPC will make any necessary relaying changes at Dawson Crossing.
